correctness.rationale: Exact defect forward substitution gives V_j=F+sum Psi^k(F^2-F), converging by ||Psi||<1. Similarity via D=F(I-F)>0 makes V_infinity symmetric-similar with top eigenvalue below one. The Schur complement transforms its bottom-eigenvalue-above-minus-one condition into Psi < (I+F^2)(I+F)^-1, including exact equality and negative directions. The rational 2x2 trace/determinant and eigenvalues are independently checked. 9,800 exact finite endpoints and several algebraic identities passed in check.py; general proof is analytic.
